[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Top_Schematic.png|thumb|right|250px|Top schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6 showing the unit's Data Retrieval Processor.]]
A '''Data Retrieval Processor''' was a component installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]]. The unit had at least two Data Retrieval Processors embedded into the outer case of the unit.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
